criteria.text: Both arms freeze the same task, source, model, effort, tool versions, outcome rules and coverage; the baseline includes the current one-call wait.
The report separates the coordinator, each child and interpreter, with requests, cached and uncached input, output, wall time, outcome and provenance; missing usage stays unknown.
The report separates internal polling, saved-report reads and model-driven status requests, and distinguishes supplied context bytes from measured input or retained history.
Overlapping durations and cached or nested usage are not counted twice; synthetic exercises cannot establish savings, dollar claims or a numeric regression target.

cases.given: Prepare two arms of the same task with current shipped and revised guidance.
cases.required_observation: AC1: Inspect frozen task/source, version/model/effort/cache/order/coverage and guidance bytes. Any mismatch remains a comparability limit; no live launch without budget authorization.

cases.given: Synthetic coordinator receipt total 1000 input, 600 cached, 100 output; child total 500, 100 cached, 50 output; duplicate coordinator receipt; interpreter usage absent.
cases.required_observation: AC2, AC4: Coordinator is 1 request, 400 uncached; child is 1 request, 400 uncached. Known authoring total input 1500 includes 700 cached and 800 uncached; output 150. Interpreter remains unknown; duplicate identity contributes nothing.

cases.given: Synthetic coordinator interval 0–10 seconds; child 2–8; overall arm 0–10.
cases.required_observation: AC2, AC4: Role durations are 10 and 6 seconds; elapsed is 10, not 16. Missing terminal outcomes or usage stay unknown; failed/aborted runs remain listed.

cases.given: Synthetic 75 internal polls, 2 saved reads, 1 model-driven status request and context file inventory.
cases.required_observation: AC3: Report the categories separately; saved-read count does not establish model turns. Bytes supplied are not tokens actually consumed or retained. Unknown retained history stays unavailable.

cases.given: Only synthetic traces or unequal outcomes are available; no controlled live baseline exists.
cases.required_observation: AC1, AC4: Label synthetic and comparison limits. Do not assert savings, dollar cost or numeric regression targets. Keep raw scripts/logs/results outside the product commit.
